shots.content: Curly-haired creator on a sunny balcony gesturing at a half-visible product box she seems to be looking into, talking to camera.
shots.note: Client 00003296 'what is she looking into? product? also dull in sunlight makes no sense'. Use MEERA's dull, matte BEFORE face as B-roll (no box, no sunlight premise) under the rewritten L1.

shots.content: AI colour wheel on stone with a lavender dollop; yellow is not opposite purple.
shots.note: L2+L3 (rewritten): the correct animated wheel full-screen with purple exactly opposite yellow, an arrow between them, and the yellow segment neutralising on 'helps cancel yellow-looking dullness'. 3.9 s holds the whole explanation.

shots.content: Tube squeezing a lavender swirl onto the back of a hand, pointed nozzle visible.
shots.note: L4 'And no, it doesn't stay purple.' S3+S4+S5 (6.6-10.6 = 4.0 s) become ONE PS08 clip at 1.25x. Here clip 0-1.9 s: the lavender stripe on MEERA's dusky hand (no tube in frame, so no nozzle).

shots.content: Two wrists side by side, one with a pale lavender/white cast.
shots.note: Continuation of PS08 (clip 1.9-2.7 s): fingertips start rubbing the stripe.

shots.content: Fingers rubbing cream on the hand, leaving a visible whitish cast.
shots.note: Client 00003295 'looks like a cast. pls blend'. End of PS08 (clip 2.7-5.0 s): the lavender fully vanishes with no cast and no residue, leaving a radiant patch, under L5 'It blends clear on Indian skin, no white cast'. Keep the 'BLENDS CLEAR / NO WHITE CAST' pill and HUD.

shots.content: Creator facing camera with lavender dots on forehead, nose, cheeks and chin, fingers starting to blend.
shots.note: L6 (niacinamide, Instant Glow, same skin tone). Two library clips: PS04_dot_face clip 0-1.5 s (dots, blending starts), then PS05_blend_glow clip 2.5-5.0 s (lavender melts away, skin becomes dewy with an Instant Glow, she lowers her hand and smiles). This is the missing application -> blended -> glow beat.

shots.content: AI before/after split face, with no visible difference between the halves and baked-in BEFORE/AFTER text.
shots.note: Client 00003294 'no difference visible'. Vertical half/half: left PS07_before_dull, right PS06_glow_after, labels 'BEFORE' / 'INSTANT GLOW'. 1.66 s is short, so if possible pull the cut in to 14.2 (end PS05 earlier) to hold the split about 2 s.

shots.content: Creator holding the tube in an SPF bubble graphic on the balcony, talking to camera.
shots.note: L7 'SPF 50 PA+++ keeps my daytime protection covered.' MEERA steps into the sun with glowing, even skin and no cast, so the video ends on a face. Keep the SPF bubble super on top.
